{{Quote|Stieg has no organized government or ruling system. Tribes are locked in constant warfare.''"<br />"''Hold on. The Stieg-Fan are peaceful and fun-loving. And Stieg has a perfectly fine system of government!|V-Davi and Siri Tachi|<ref name="Fight" />}}
The '''Stieg-Fan''' were the tribes living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stieg]],<ref name="Fight" /> which was located in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> They were known of in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]<ref name="Fight" /> by [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]</ref> and were generally considered to be an irenic and sociable group with a stable government. However, on the planet [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]],<ref name="Fight" /> another world in the Calaron sector,<ref name="Atlas" /> the Stieg-Fan were part of a [[The Learning|propaganda system]] implemented in the [[Learning Circle|local school system]] designed to portray the wider galaxy as dangerous. As part of this effort, the Stieg-Fan were described as locked in constant warfare between tribes, with no provision for the rule of law. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] tried to correct this belief when it was shared by [[V-Davi]], an orphaned [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] living on Kegan, however Tachi's correction was rejected by V-Davi's [[Teaching Guide]], [[O-Bin]].<ref name="Fight" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Stieg-Fan were mentioned in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]'', the ninth book in the young reader series ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]''. The book was written by [[Jude Watson]] and published in [[2000]].<ref name="Fight" />
